card.name: Linking words before local anesthetic names
card.fires_on: Commas, 'as', 'of', 'and' or '%' that sit right before a local anesthetic name such as lidocaine, tetracaine, benzocaine or bupivacaine, in lists or examples of these drugs.

modes.label: Comma in anesthetic lists
modes.description: A comma between caine-type drug names in a list of local anesthetics.

modes.label: Linking word before anesthetic
modes.description: 'as', 'of', 'and' or '%' directly before an anesthetic drug is named.
